DitherHorizon.horizon: Height of the horizon's highest point from the bottom, 0 to 1.
DitherHorizon.curve: How round the planet is, 0 (nearly flat) to 1 (a small globe).
DitherHorizon.glow: Strength of the glow above the horizon, 0 to 1.
DitherHorizon.aurora: How much the glow ripples into aurora curtains, 0 (a smooth band) to 1.
DitherHorizon.glow-color: Colour of the glow, rim and stars.
DitherHorizon.sky-color: Colour of the sky and the planet.
